description: Robin's struggle expands from local resistance to a conspiracy against King Richard, as the Pact of Nottingham, Marian's double life and Allan's divided loyalty draw the outlaws toward the Holy Land.

s02e01.description: Robin's return to Sherwood is immediately tested when Knighton Hall is destroyed and Marian and Edward are arrested by the Sheriff.

s02e02.description: A lavish casino at Nottingham Castle hides the Sheriff's silver behind an elaborate death-trap strongroom, giving Robin an irresistible target.

s02e03.description: Children stumble onto Gisborne's secret weapons testing site, and Robin must beat both an armored opponent and the clock to save them.

s02e04.description: A chemical weapon is tested on Nottingham's poor while Will's father is killed for discovering the truth, pushing Will toward revenge.

s02e05.description: A captured spy threatens to expose the gang while the Sheriff prepares to drown a healer as a witch, and Robin realizes a traitor may be among his own.

s02e06.description: Robin discovers the Black Knights gathering to sign a pact against King Richard, only to learn that the nobleman he needs as an ally is corrupt.

s02e07.description: A lovelorn knight's silver becomes Robin's route to the Sheriff's treasure and the Great Pact, while Allan's betrayal places Marian in growing danger.

s02e08.description: An assassin infiltrates the outlaws with a personal vendetta against Robin, but his motive offers Robin a chance to turn the weapon back on the Sheriff.

s02e09.description: A dying royal messenger leaves Robin a cryptic clue about 'Lardner', sending both the outlaws and Gisborne after the same hidden secret.

s02e10.description: The Sheriff wanders into Sherwood while Prince John's envoy threatens to destroy Nottingham, forcing Gisborne to rely on Robin to find their missing enemy.

s02e11.description: A coded trail from the King's guard sends Robin after the mysterious Thesaurus Patriae, a national treasure whose true nature surprises everyone hunting it.

s02e12.description: A birthday ambush traps the outlaws while the Sheriff and Gisborne head for the Holy Land with a plan to murder King Richard.

s02e13.description: Robin, Marian and the outlaws reach the Holy Land to warn King Richard, only to find the Sheriff's conspiracy has already made them appear to be traitors.
